$comment: The installed app's icons, drawn from public/favicon.svg by scripts/generate-icons.mjs into public/icons/. `sha256` is the favicon's hash when the icons were last drawn, so test/offline-assets.test.ts fails after an edit to the favicon until the icons are drawn again. `background` is the light page colour from docs/design/book-tokens.json, and `mark` is the share of the icon's width the favicon's 64-unit box takes: the maskable icon keeps the mark inside the centre circle of 80% of its width, which every launcher's mask leaves visible.
